name: singlet_sample_level_sample_phenotype_prediction
title: Sample-level phenotype prediction
description: Predicts a binary label for each donor from that donor's cells and reports donor-held-out AUROC, calibration and a donor-level permutation null. Use it to predict a donor-level label for donors unseen in fitting; the default is a penalised logistic model on donor pseudobulk. Writes predictions, metrics, null tables, cell-type importance and a fitted model. Do not use it for cell-level labels, unsupervised stratification or continuous outcomes.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Donor model: pseudobulk_enet (default) or a forest on donor cell-type composition only.

sample_key.description: obs column with the sample ID of each cell.

label_key.description: obs column or uns/sample_table column with a binary label (0 or 1), constant within each donor.

design.description: Donor identity, cohort, cell-type and validation settings shared by all methods.

donor_key.description: obs column with the donor ID; defaults to sample_key.

cohort_key.description: obs column with cohort or study ID; enables leave-cohort-out and stratified permutation.

cell_type_key.description: obs column with cell-type labels for per-type pseudobulk and composition features.

cv.description: Outer validation scheme; all splits are grouped by donor.

n_perm.description: Donor-level label permutations within cohort strata for the null.

n_hvg.description: Highly variable genes, selected inside training folds only.

pseudobulk_enet.description: Options for the penalised logistic model on donor pseudobulk.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells per donor pseudobulk (decoupler default).

min_counts.description: Minimum total counts per donor pseudobulk (decoupler default).

alpha.description: Starting elastic-net mixing (1 is lasso); inner grouped CV also searches alpha.

celltype_proportion_rf.description: Options for the forest on donor cell-type composition.

pseudocount.description: Pseudocount added before the centred log-ratio of proportions.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

seed.description: Random seed for donor splits, permutations and model initialisation.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: fitted and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/phenotype_predictions. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: n_donors, n_cases, n_controls, auroc, auroc_ci, balanced_accuracy, brier, ece, perm_p, top_cell_types.

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
